name: Saline River — Peeler Bend Boat Ramp to Jenkins Ferry Boat Ramp
blurb: The upper Saline River near Benton between AGFC accesses on the Saline River Water Trail and further downstream ramps.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Peeler Bend Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Lyle Park Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. AGFC Saline River Water Trail: low-water bridge at mile marker 11.6 (34.6003, −92.6192) — paddlers must duck under it at 5.1–5.5 ft on the Benton gauge, and at 6 ft there is not enough air space and it is mandatory to portage around it. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: AGFC water-trail distance table.

guideTimes.conditions: AGFC: 'Peeler Bend to Lyle Park (3.8 miles/2-3 hours)' listed for Benton gauge (USGS 07363000) levels from low (3.5 ft / 92 cfs and below) through high (5.1-5.5 ft); AGFC: 6 ft+ / above 1620 cfs is too high, not recommended.

sections.accessReview: AGFC documents a low-water bridge on this reach that can block boats as water rises. Confirm a safe, legal portage and current river conditions before using this listing. Do not rely on the map or a gauge height alone to pass beneath the bridge.
